title: carduus stenolepis
intro: Carduus stenolepis, commonly known as the narrow-leaved thistle, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to Europe and Asia. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Carduus stenolepis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and improving immune function. The plant contains bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
